# Direct Action

## By the end of today

You will be able to treat the First Amendment as a toolkit and place common tactics on a spectrum from petition to civil disobedience.

Speech, press, assembly, and petition are one toolkit.

Organized contact is petition with a list. Protest is assembly plus speech. Citizen journalism and filming the police in public are press. *Turner v. Driver* (5th Cir. 2017): recording police is a basic, vital, and well-established liberty if you do not interfere.

Civil disobedience is public, nonviolent, intentional lawbreaking. Arrest is part of the point. That is where First Amendment protection ends.
